jobs.title: Implementation Engineer - Quantum Networking & Security
jobs.description:
Site readiness, deployment, integration, testing, documentation, and customer handoff

Location U.S.-based; flexible/remote within the United States, with frequent travel to customer and partner sites

Work Authorization U.S. work authorization is required

Employment Full-time Function Professional Services / Customer Engineering

Travel Approximately 30%-50%, including scheduled maintenance and implementation windows

Compensation Competitive base salary, delivery or company incentive, and benefits

Position Summary

Quantum Foundry is seeking a hands-on Implementation Engineer to own post-sale technical delivery from accepted design handoff through production readiness and operational transition. This role plans site readiness, stages and installs equipment, configures and integrates multivendor solutions, executes testing, resolves implementation issues, maintains accurate documentation, and prepares customer teams to operate and support the deployed environment. The ideal candidate has strong routing and switching experience, disciplined field-engineering practices, customer-facing communication skills, and broad exposure to optical networking, fiber infrastructure, cybersecurity, microsegmentation, encryption, QKD, PQC, and key-management integration

Key Responsibilities

**Review the contracted architecture, BOM, scope, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, POC results, schedule, partner responsibilities, and acceptance criteria before deployment begins.**

Lead site-readiness reviews covering rack space, power, grounding, cooling, physical security, fiber paths, optics, cabling, management access, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, certificates, monitoring, and change controls.

**Develop detailed designs, implementation plans, Methods of Procedure, rollback plans, test procedures, maintenance-window plans, change-control packages, configuration records, and as-built documentation.**

Stage, install, configure, integrate, and validate routers, switches, firewalls, optical systems, servers, encryption platforms, QKD equipment, PQC-enabled products, key-management systems, and supporting infrastructure.

**Configure and troubleshoot TCP/IP routing, switching, VLANs, segmentation, microsegmentation, VPNs, high availability, network services, monitoring, logging, and management connectivity.**

Validate optical and fiber readiness, including connector condition, patching, optics, wavelength plans, end-to-end loss measurements, attenuation, receive levels, continuity, and transport dependencies.

**Integrate QKD systems and key-management components with customer PKI, HSMs, certificates, encryptors, routing and switching infrastructure, firewalls, identity platforms, monitoring systems, and change-management processes.**

Implement and validate cybersecurity controls, including secure management, access controls, microsegmentation, firewall policy, logging, certificate handling, and secure configuration practices.

**Execute functional, interoperability, resiliency, security, performance, failure-recovery, and acceptance testing; collect evidence and manage defects and remediation through closure.**

Troubleshoot complex network, optical, fiber, cryptographic, software, API, configuration, and performance issues and coordinate escalation with OEMs, carriers, partners, and internal resources.

**Own the field implementation workstream, including technical schedule, daily status, risks, issues, dependencies, customer communications, scope control, and readiness for go-live.**

Deliver administrator training, knowledge transfer, operational runbooks, as-built records, customer acceptance materials, and a structured handoff to operations and support.

**Support post-go-live stabilization and capture lessons learned, product defects, and reusable improvements for future deployments.**

Required Qualifications

**Five or more years of experience implementing, integrating, testing, or supporting enterprise network, security, data-center, or infrastructure solutions in customer environments.**

Hands-on expertise in TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, LAN/WAN, VPNs, segmentation, high availability, network services, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

**Experience with site-readiness assessment, equipment staging, installation, configuration, change control, cutover support, rollback, and customer acceptance.**

Ability to develop MOPs, low-level designs, test procedures, rollback plans, as-built documentation, operational runbooks, and customer training materials.

**Strong customer communication and project discipline, including the ability to explain risks, manage technical expectations, and coordinate multiple contributors.**  Ability to travel regularly to customer locations and support scheduled maintenance windows, including evenings or weekends when required.

**Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.**

U.S. work authorization and the ability to travel within the United States for implementation activity.

Desired Experience

**Optical networking and fiber infrastructure, including DWDM, coherent transport, optical power and loss measurements, attenuation, fiber inspection, cleaning, troubleshooting, and test equipment.**

Cybersecurity implementation involving firewalls, zero trust, network access control, microsegmentation, PKI, certificates, TLS, IPsec, identity, secure management, logging, or vulnerability remediation.

**QKD architectures and operations, PQC-enabled technologies, crypto-agility, key-management systems, HSMs, network encryptors, or hybrid cryptography.**

Integration of QKD or external key-management systems using certificates, APIs, ETSI interfaces, or vendor-specific protocols. **Juniper, Cisco, Arista, Nokia, Ciena, HPE Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, F5, Kentik, or comparable platforms.**  Python, shell scripting, APIs, configuration management, automation, test harnesses, or infrastructure-as-code. **NIST PQC standards such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA and guidance related to quantum-safe migration.**  Relevant networking, cybersecurity, cloud, Linux, optical, or project-delivery certifications.

Measures of Success **Deployments are completed safely, on schedule, within approved scope, and against documented acceptance criteria.**  Site-readiness gaps and delivery dependencies are identified early and managed effectively. **Functional and performance testing succeeds with limited rework and disciplined defect closure.**  Customer documentation, as-built records, training, and support handoff are complete and usable. **Post-go-live stabilization is efficient and customer operations teams are prepared to manage the solution.**  Reusable automation, configurations, MOPs, and delivery playbooks reduce future deployment effort.

About Quantum Foundry Quantum Foundry helps commercial, public-sector, research, and education organizations modernize enterprise infrastructure while preparing for quantum-era security and computing. The company integrates networking, optical transport, cybersecurity, data-center, QKD, PQC, professional services, and managed services into practical customer solutions. Application Information

Submit a resume and a brief summary of relevant customer-facing engineering experience to https://quantumfoundry.ai/careers-1

Equal Employment Opportunity Quantum Foundry is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Quantum Foundry does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist (for Digital Marketing Agency)
jobs.description:
Client success pros and onboarding coordinators: We’re looking for someone to own the first 7 days of every new client at a fast-growing marketing company in the med spa space.

So if you’ve ever watched a great client slip through the cracks because no one owned the details, and thought “I would never let that happen,” we want to talk to you. Come be the person who makes sure every new client launches fast, feels taken care of, and starts winning from week one.

If you're the person who always has the checklist, chases the loose ends, and loves the feeling of getting something launched on time, this role was built for you. Join a fast-growing remote team where you’ll get to own the client experience from day one and see the impact of your work every single week.

**About Us**

Mr Med Spa helps med spa owners grow with a done-for-you patient acquisition system and consulting. That includes offer and messaging, ads and lead generation, lead nurture, and a consultative sales process that sells high ticket packages instead of discounts.

We launched in mid-2026 and grew fast. Every new client signs up expecting results quickly. The first 7 days decide whether they get them.

**The Role**

You own the first 7–10 days of every new client relationship, from the moment a deal is closed to the moment their campaigns go live.

Your job is to get every client fully set up, with every login connected and every form completed, live on time with nothing missed. Then you hand them off to their account manager ready to grow.

This is a role for someone who chases details, follows up without being asked, and can't sleep when a checklist item is still open.

**What You'll Do**

* Run the access call with each new client. You'll get Meta, Google, and other platform access granted live on the call instead of waiting on emails.
* Make sure every client completes the onboarding form, the appointment setter form, and CRM connection.
* Work each new client's onboarding checklist to completion, and chase down every open item with the client and the internal team.
* Hit our go-live standard: every client live within 7 days of signup when the access call happens within 48 hours, and no later than 10 days otherwise.
* Get them their first win!
* Coordinate with our tech, media buying, and appointment-setting teams so creative, campaigns, and lead routing are ready on schedule.
* Run end-to-end test-lead QA before launch to confirm leads flow from ad to CRM to setter to calendar.
* Walk clients through our online community, onboarding trainings, and how to request support.
* Hand off each launched client to their account manager with a clean summary of where everything stands.
* Flag stalled onboarding's early and escalate when a client isn't responding.
* Keep onboarding status in project management and CRM accurate every day, so anyone on the team can see where every client stands.
* Spot what keeps breaking and suggest fixes to the onboarding process and its automations.

**What Success Looks Like**

* 90%+ of clients live within 7 days of signup
* Zero clients launched without passing test-lead QA
* No onboarding goes more than 48 hours without client contact
* Account managers receive clients with nothing missing
* New clients describe onboarding as fast and organized

**Who You Are**

* 1–3+ years in client onboarding, client success, account coordination, or project coordination, ideally at an agency or SaaS company
* Comfortable on live video calls with business owners, including walking a non-technical person through Meta Business Manager or Google permissions
* Highly organized, a checklist-driven person who closes loops
* A clear, friendly, fast communicator over Zoom, email, SMS, and Slack
* Calm under pressure while juggling several onboardings at once
* Coachable, and you take ownership instead of waiting to be told

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with digital marketing, META, and Google
* Experience with GoHighLevel, Asana, Zapier, or Circle
* Experience in med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, or marketing agencies
* Familiarity with HIPAA-conscious handling of client data

**Details**

* Reports to our head of fulfillment, our co-founder
* 40 hours per week
* Location: Remote

**How to Apply**

Apply directly here on indeed and we will be in touch with a short application.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Agency Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Agency Onboarding Specialist**

**CarePortal**

#### **Organizational Profile**

CarePortal is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis. We believe that through the Church and Community, there can be More Than Enough care for every child, through the power of Care-Sharing and the love of Jesus. Our goal is to **scale meaningful connections** through the local church, making a lasting impact on the lives of everyone involved. We mobilize robust Care-Sharing Networks and lead with **Courage, Humility, and Excellence.**

We do this through the local Church and in collaboration with child-serving organizations, businesses, and people who care—that’s where you come in.

### **Position Summary**

### **The Agency Onboarding Specialist is responsible for guiding new agencies through onboarding to ensure they are prepared to submit high-quality, approved requests that connect children and families to meaningful support.**

### **This role focuses on efficient, high-quality activation, helping agencies understand both how to use the platform and how to clearly communicate needs in a way that leads to timely and meaningful care.**

### **While the role is supportive and relational during onboarding, it is not responsible for ongoing engagement. Success is defined by accuracy, confidence, and readiness at first submission, enabling a clean transition to the Engagement team. Network health metrics, scorecards and KPIs will be utilized to help gauge performance, however, success in this role will be measured across all of the responsibilities listed below.**

### **Your Responsibilities Include:**

**Onboarding Delivery**

* Facilitate onboarding sessions for new agencies
* Guide agencies through platform setup and request submission process

**Activation & First Submission**

* Prepare agencies to submit their first approved request
* Ensure understanding of quality standards for submissions

**Customer Experience**

* Provide clear, supportive guidance throughout onboarding
* Ensure agencies feel confident in using the platform

**Process Consistency & Improvement**

* Follow onboarding standards and playbooks
* Provide feedback to improve efficiency and clarity
* Support efforts to reduce onboarding complexity

**Coordination & Handoff**

* Ensure onboarding milestones are completed accurately
* Transition agencies to Engagement after first approved submission
* Support ecosystem balance through participation in Network Leader facilitated strategy meetings to identify, discuss and solve issues and opportunities.

### **What You Bring to the Organization:**

#### **Experience & Skills**

* Understanding of agencies, caseworkers, and the broader social services system
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead virtual training sessions
* Ability to guide customers through structured processes with clarity and confidence
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through
* Comfort with virtual training environments and technology platforms
* Ability to balance efficiency with a positive, supportive customer experience
* Experience with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and virtual meeting tools preferred
* Ability to follow defined processes while identifying opportunities for improvement
* Passion for CarePortal’s mission and commitment to Courage, Humility, and Excellence

The above description is not intended to be comprehensive, but rather a focused list of priorities. Success provides the opportunity to not only build a career but also bring much-needed support and care to local children and families in crisis across the United States. Successful candidates, like all CarePortal, LLC employees, are expected to live and work consistent with CarePortal’s vision, mission, and values.

CarePortal, LLC, a subsidiary of the nonprofit organization The Global Orphan Project (GO Project), is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis.

This platform, which brings Christian churches to the point of care for each request made on behalf of children and families, can be used to connect a diverse network of churches, child-serving agencies, businesses, and individuals who care. Learn more at www.careportal.org.

*CarePortal, LLC offers a competitive benefits package for full-time positions (30+ hours per week) including health, dental, vision and employer paid life insurance, retirement savings and generous PTO plan and a highly competitive, market-indexed compensation when compared to similar non-profit roles. Compensation is commensurate with relevant skills and experience.*

The Global Orphan Project is a 501c3 nonprofit located at 3161 Wyandotte, Kansas City, MO 64111.

CarePortal LLC associates are at-will employees.

www.goproject.org www.careportal.org

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks like**:

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  
  
First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.  
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

* Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
* 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
* Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

**What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!**  
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!  
  
***The salary range for this position is approximately $80-90K USD annually.*** *This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.*

**We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!**

Follow us:

* Facebook
* Instagram
* LinkedIn
* X
* YouTube

***Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage***  
*First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**About the Operations team**  
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

**About the Role**  
As an Implementation Support Specialist I, you'll combine your exceptional technical and communications skills to support the implementation of the Affirm solution with our growing network of retail partners. You will serve as a primary support contact for our partners' business and technical teams throughout the integration process, while working cross-functionally with Affirm's Engineering and Merchant Operations teams to help provide clients with quick solutions, troubleshoot account issues, and build internal processes that scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide exemplary support to merchant partners on topics including: marketing best practices, accounting workflows, implementation guidance / troubleshooting
* Resolve technical integration issues related to partners' ecommerce front-end platforms and back-end order management systems
* Identify and implement new operational processes to drive efficiency
* Develop detailed technical documentation
* Engage with internal stakeholders to define cross-functional workflows
* Provide product feedback from clients to the Product and Engineering teams to improve overall product performance and feature set

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 1-3 years of experience in relevant industry (Tech, eCommerce, SaaS) and/or similar role(s)
* Past success in a job, internship, or volunteer role that required written communication with stakeholders, customers, or partners
* Exceptional project management, communication, and technical skills to manage client engagements and internal resources
* Proven ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, work independently and drive projects to completion with minimum guidance and high attention to detail
* Nice to have: experience working with major e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc) or exposure to web development concepts
* Nice to have : Previous experience in the payments or ecommerce space
* Nice to have: knowledge of of HTML, Javascript, API's

**This role requires candidates to be based in the Pacific Time Zone.**

Pay Grade - D  
Equity Grade - 1  
  
**Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.** Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.  
  
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)  
  
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $70,000 - $90,000  
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $62,000 - $82,000

**#LI-Remote**

**Remote-first with flexibility built in**  
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

**Benefits designed for you**  
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

* Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
* Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
* Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
* Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Base salary: $85,000 – $105,000 USD

Remote – United States | Full-Time

At Helm Operations, we build the software that keeps the world’s maritime operations moving. From tugboats in Vancouver Harbour to offshore service vessels in the North Sea, our customers run their businesses with Helm CONNECT. And we don’t take that lightly.

We’ve grown from a small start-up on Canada’s west coast into a global leader serving many of the world’s largest maritime companies. Our mission is simple: deliver software that connects the marine industry like no other technology company.

But world-class software doesn’t happen by accident. It takes tough teams, ownership, and deep care for customers. That’s The Helm Way.

Now, we’re looking for an Implementation Specialist who can turn complex technology into real-world results. Ideally, you bring maritime industry experience, understand the challenges our customers face, and enjoy helping businesses work smarter.

Your Mission

As an Implementation Specialist, you'll help maritime companies successfully implement Helm CONNECT and get real value from their investment.

You'll work directly with customers to understand their operations, configure solutions, troubleshoot challenges, and deliver training from implementation through go-live. More than a software specialist, you'll be a trusted advisor, helping customers improve their processes and operational performance.

Working alongside Project Managers, Developers, and fellow Implementation Specialists, you'll take ownership of your deliverables and help ensure successful customer outcomes.

You Will

* Partner with Project Managers to plan and deliver successful Helm CONNECT implementations, meeting agreed timelines, milestones, and quality standards.
* Gather and document customer requirements, configure software and data, and ensure solutions support their operational needs.
* Understand maritime workflows across vessel operations, maintenance, compliance, logistics, and personnel management to recommend practical improvements.
* Deliver customer training, workshops, and demonstrations remotely and onsite, helping customers confidently adopt Helm CONNECT.
* Troubleshoot complex technical and operational issues, perform quality assurance testing, and support customers through go-live.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, services, or training that create value for customers.
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Product, Development, and Support teams, including documenting requirements for custom development.
* Proactively communicate project progress, risks, and challenges while maintaining accurate documentation, customer records, and time entries.
* Share knowledge and best practices to continuously improve how we deliver implementations.

You Bring

* 5+ years of experience implementing complex operational software, enterprise systems, or SaaS solutions.
* Maritime industry experience strongly preferred, particularly in workboat operations, harbour docking, barging, fleet management, vessel maintenance, or marine logistics.
* Strong technical aptitude in software configuration, data management, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.
* Experience gathering business requirements, consulting with customers, and translating operational needs into practical solutions.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and customer service skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, shifting priorities, and deadlines.
* A proactive, customer-focused approach with confidence navigating challenging situations.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience leveraging AI tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* A university degree, college diploma, or relevant technical accreditation.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, primarily across North America, with occasional international travel.

Bonus Points

* Direct experience working for a maritime operator or implementing maritime software.
* Knowledge of maritime safety, compliance, maintenance, logistics, or vessel operations.
* Experience with ERP or fleet management systems.
* Project management training or PMI certification.
* Experience delivering software training or supporting organizational change.
* Spanish language proficiency.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

* Become certified in Helm CONNECT's four core product lines: Maintenance, Compliance, Logistics, and Personnel.
* Build strong relationships with customers and internal teams while developing a solid understanding of maritime operations.
* Take ownership of implementation activities for a complex customer, managing requirements, configuration, and delivery milestones.

Beyond 90 Days

* Independently deliver successful implementations on time, within scope, and to customer expectations.
* Help customers achieve measurable value from Helm CONNECT while maintaining strong satisfaction scores.
* Meet billable utilization targets and contribute to quarterly and annual performance goals.
* Become a trusted customer advisor and help improve Helm's implementation processes through shared knowledge and best practices.

Why You'll Love Working at Helm

At Helm, we don't just keep the world's maritime operations running—we keep our people growing. You'll join a global team that values ownership, teamwork, and getting things done, while still making time to enjoy the journey.

We live by our core values:

* Together We Win – We share knowledge, support each other, and work together to deliver great customer outcomes.
* Own It – We take responsibility, follow through on our commitments, and find solutions when challenges arise.
* Care Deeply – About our customers, our work, and the people we work alongside.
* Enjoy the Ride – We work hard, celebrate our wins, and have fun along the way.

Perks & Benefits

* 100% remote role based in United States
* Flexible working hours with availability during core business hours and as required for customer implementations.
* Competitive compensation with On-Target Earnings (OTE):

$93,500 – $115,500 USD OTE

Base salary: $85,000 – $105,000 USD

* Opportunities to work directly with leading maritime companies across North America and beyond.
* Professional development through Helm's learning programs and development journeys.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and globally connected team where your ideas and contributions matter.
* Additional benefits and eligibility will be outlined based on your country of employment.

*\* Actual compensation will depend on the candidate's relevant skills, experience, qualifications, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market conditions. On-Target Earnings (OTE) include base salary plus a target annual performance bonus, subject to the terms of Helm's performance bonus program. Actual bonus payments may vary based on applicable performance criteria.\**

\**As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.* \*

\**Research has shown that women & under-represented minorities read lists of requirements and consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single one. This list represents what we are ideally looking for, but we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet everything 100%. jobs.title: Implementation Success Partner
jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

As a **Senior Surgical Growth Implementation Success Partner**, you will lead the most complex perioperative deployments in our portfolio, multi-service-line, multi-site, and executive-facing engagements where the bar for delivery, influence, and autonomy is highest. You will own the full implementation lifecycle from pre-sale collaboration through hypercare, partnering with Sales early to shape scope and set delivery expectations, and serving as the strategic advisor to perioperative executives, surgeons, schedulers, and IT teams once delivery is underway.

This role blends engagement leadership, executive stakeholder management, technical fluency, and analytics. You will operate with broad autonomy, escalating only the highest-risk or strategic matters, and you will be expected to anticipate risks before they materialize, design mitigation strategies proactively, and guide client decision-making at the executive level. Your fluency with Qventus dashboards and reporting will allow you to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and ROI.

Your deep understanding of the product, perioperative operations, and EHR architecture will allow you to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement, maximizing value for clients and positively impacting healthcare operations. Join us and help revolutionize the healthcare landscape with cutting-edge technology and strategic implementation.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Partner with Sales prior to delivery handoff to shape scope, validate feasibility, and set clear delivery expectations for enterprise perioperative engagements.
* Define and manage the timeline for enterprise-wide deployment of the Qventus Periop Solution across multiple service lines and facilities.
* Lead large, complex perioperative implementations involving multiple service lines, surgeon groups, and executive stakeholders.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to perioperative leadership and the C-suite, facilitating executive-level discussions and guiding client decision-making on scope, risk, and operational strategy.
* Build and manage relationships at every level of client organizations, with a particular focus on influencing executive and senior operational stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Specialists, and Client Success Partners throughout each deployment to identify and implement solutions that maximize client value.
* Partner with operational and technical client teams to ensure periop implementation requirements and needs are met.
* Leverage deep functional periop expertise to create and sustain buy-in from core users, executives, and surgeons around workflows and tool adoption.
* Anticipate risks before they materialize, design proactive mitigation strategies, and advise internal and external leaders on resolution paths.
* Demonstrate fluency across Qventus dashboards and reporting tools to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and value realization.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, implement structured approaches to close gaps, and lead change management efforts to ensure successful workflow adoption and long-term sustainability.
* Act as the primary owner of the implementation for assigned client accounts, operating with broad autonomy and accountability and escalating only the highest-risk or strategic matters.
* Articulate Qventus' value proposition and create value for customers by establishing clearly defined business outcomes.
* Create a customer base who is excited about Qventus and serves as a reference for prospective customers.
* A passion for fixing our healthcare system.

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

* 8+ years of project/program management experience with a comprehensive understanding of the business requirements and technical capabilities needed for an enterprise-wide SaaS implementation.
* 8+ years of professional experience working at a top healthcare consulting firm, digital health company, or health system.
* 8+ years of experience working cross-functionally with multiple teams, both internally and externally, to manage end-to-end project lifecycles and to drive project milestones to completion.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, complex implementations with executive  
  engagement.
* Proven track record collaborating with Sales or pre-sales teams to scope, validate, and hand off enterprise deployments.
* Knowledge of perioperative metrics, processes, challenges, and solutions; ability to engage in strategic and operational discussions with hospital leaders and surgeons.
* Fluency with Epic, Cerner, or comparable EHR environments, able to speak credibly to EHR architecture, integrations, and workflow implications without relying on technical SMEs.
* Project management experience with complex implementations in the provider-side healthcare setting.
* A track record of applying strong quantitative and analytical skills in prior roles, including fluent use of dashboards and reporting tools to drive adoption and reinforcement strategies.
* Prior experience managing projects for hospital systems (e.g., EHR implementations) is required.
* Skilled at understanding, documenting, and analyzing data using a variety of tools (data validation dashboards, interpreting JAVA/SQL code, complex Excel functions, etc.).
* Ability to travel on average 25% -35%.

  

**It's a Plus if You Have…**
----------------------------

* Experience writing SQL queries (highly desired).
* PMP certification.
* Experience working with clinical and/or process consultants.

Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). Our commitment to equal opportunity employment applies to all persons involved in our operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee, including supervisors and co-workers.

Qventus participates in the E-Verify program as required by law and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in compliance with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). In compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Qventus provides transparency into how applicant data is processed during the application process. Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our candidate privacy notice.

* Benefits and perks are subject to plan documents and may change at the company's discretion.

* Employment is contingent upon the satisfactory completion of our pre-employment background investigation and drug test.

**Job Description**
-------------------

At GDIT, we put our people first. As a Senior Business Analyst supporting the Indian Health Service, you will be entrusted to work with clinicians, developers, and federal staff to document changes and requirements for clinical applications.

  

This a REMOTE BASED ROLE. Candidate must live in the US.

\*\* Work visa sponsorship will no be provided for this position \*\*

  

**How the Senior Business Analyst will make an Impact:**

* Analyze user and stakeholder needs to define functional and non-functional requirements across projects for the electronic health record system.
* Document and manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle within the requirements repository (Azure DevOps).
* Perform functional modeling to support requirements analysis and solution design.
* Manage project backlogs and support prioritization activities.
* Consult with clients to determine optimal design solutions for assigned projects.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including requirements documents, user manuals, addendums, presentations, and training materials.
* Assist in developing test use cases and scripts for user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with software development teams and comply with contract reporting requirements.
* Collect and report metrics related to requirements and client-identified priorities.
* Respond to inquiries from clients, clinicians, field personnel, developers, and other stakeholders.
* Provide status reports to the PMO and/or Lead Analyst.
* Participate in special projects as assigned.
  

**What You Will Need to Succeed:**

* Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, and work experience as described below.
* 8+ years of technical requirements analysis and Requirements Engineering (RE) experience using Waterfall and Agile SDLC methodologies.
* Experience creating process and data flow diagrams, prototypes, and wireframes.
* Experience managing change control activities, including backlog management, scope control, and impact/gap analysis.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of applications, including Microsoft Visio.
* Experience writing use cases and user stories.
* Ability to clearly explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated success working in a collaborative team environment with shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Proven ability to work on a remote or geographically dispersed team.
* Minimal travel (once per year) may be required.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* IIBA certification Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA).
* Experience working with and knowledge of electronic health record systems (EHR, Pharmacy, Immunizations, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Quality Reporting) highly desired
* Experience with the Indian Health Service RPMS and/or Veterans Administration VistA EHR systems.
* Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and/or Team Foundation Server.
* Knowledge of Planview and/or Unanet.
  

**Location:** Remote within the USA

  

**Clearance Level:** Requires the ability to pass an IHS background check and meet the residency requirement for having resided in the US at least (3) three out of the last (5) five years in order to obtain an appropriate level Public Trust Level 5 (MBI or T2) clearance.

  

**What GDIT Can Offer You:**

* Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home, with core work hours Monday – Friday 9:00 AM ET – 3:00 PM local time.
* 401K with company match.
